text_block_list.text:
One day, Rulership was cheerfully reading
through a mountain of fan letters she had received.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll let you hear them too.
The voices praising the ruler of the board!

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter A
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Rulership,
Your last race was
so totally cool!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter A
text_block_list.text:
"Flawless racecraft, the perfect timing for your final spurt.
It felt like every single piece clicked right into place...
I was truly, deeply moved!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ruler-san truly is the absolute master of the board!
She's my idol!’"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if I say so myself, this race felt just right.
It seems... it really pierced the hearts of the audience too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I don't expect the same trick to work every time,
but it's worth keeping in mind
as one potential winning pattern.
choice_data_list: Are you analyzing races from your fan letters?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. It really helps a lot with
analyzing the pros and cons of tactics
and considering if there's a better move.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's see about this one.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Ruler, I'm always cheering for you!
When I first saw you miss the break by a mile,
my heart nearly stopped—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, absolutely NOT!!
choice_data_list: These are precious words from the fans. Let's read them properly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I just really hope they don't overkill me...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "『When I first saw you... that terrible late start almost gave me a heart attack, but...』"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Her late surge after that was the coolest thing ever, and I felt like I wanted to keep watching her forever!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter B
text_block_list.text: "I love seeing how hard you fight to turn the tables, Ruler!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter B
text_block_list.text: "‘I will definitely, absolutely come cheer for you next time too!’"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Unacceptable...!
Allowing a late start!"
choice_data_list: Yeah... definitely need to reflect on that part.
Yeah... we'll have to learn from that mistake.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Look at that...

However... flaws and all, the blend of light
and shadow seems to be part of the appeal
that makes her so beloved by her fans.
choice_data_list: Everyone's looking forward to what you'll do next.
Everyone's looking forward to what you'll do next.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph…… Really?
Well, I guess that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An absolute strategic victory coupled with an unexpected, epic comeback.
I'm probably the only one who can reign over such chaos.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu... I'll do it.
No matter the race, no matter how it unfolds,
I will capture the hearts of the audience.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Because that is what it truly means to be the 'Ruler of the Board'!"
